note: Real UK suppliers researched from their own pages on 2026-11-06. Lead times are often best-case figures and most prices are quote only; ask for quotes. Product context and the user registry override these by id.

machines.name: 3DPRINTUK, SLS PA12
machines.notes: Wall: natural 1 mm, shotpeen 1.5 mm, polished 2 mm. Hole minimum depends on depth: 1 mm for under 2 mm deep, 2 mm for 2 to 5 mm, 3 mm for 5 to 10 mm, 4 mm for 10 mm+. Gap: tight fit 0.15 mm, smooth fit 0.25 mm, per surface (double for diameters). Tolerance: expected 0.1 mm or 0.1%, guaranteed 0.3 mm or 0.3%. Build size: machines page and the PA12 'maximum part size' say 236 x 186 x 300 (EOS Formiga P110); the PA12 page 'max print size' says 286 x 186 x 300, so the pages disagree. Lead time in working days: Express 2-4, Economy 6-12 (estimate), Trade about 12-22; not guaranteed. Hole minimum taken as 2 mm because the screw holes are 2 to 5 mm deep.

machines.name: 3DPRINTUK, MJF PA12
machines.notes: Min wall 1 mm natural (1.5 shot peen, 2 polished). Min hole 1 mm applies to depth under 2 mm; 2 mm for 2-5 mm depth, 3 mm for 5-10 mm, 4 mm+ for over 10 mm; powder may not clear holes longer than 30 mm. Gap 0.15 mm tight fit / 0.25 mm smooth fit, per surface (double for diameters). Tolerance: expected 0.1 mm or 0.1%, guaranteed 0.3 mm or 0.3% (0.3 recorded). Parts over 10 mm thick are hollowed to 4 mm walls. Lead time from https://www.3dprint-uk.co.uk/lead-times: Express 2-4 working days, Economy 6-12 working days (estimates), trade accounts 12-22 working days. They note MJF PA12 warps more than SLS PA12.

machines.name: 3D People, SLS PA12
machines.notes: Hole: through holes 1.5 mm min plus 1 mm per 10 mm depth; blind holes 2 mm min plus 2 mm per 10 mm depth. Gap: 0.5 mm min integrated clearance for parts printed together; 0.2 mm free fit / 0.1 mm close fit for parts assembled after printing. Tolerance null: the tolerance page loads values by script and showed placeholders only. Max build 335 x 285 x 445 mm is from the general design guide (all technologies), not stated on the PA12 SLS page. Lead time 'From 2 working days'; no upper figure published.

machines.name: Protolabs, MJF PA12
machines.notes: No absolute minimum wall stated: 2.5-4.0 mm is 'ideal', 1.5 mm minimum if vapour smoothed. Minimum feature size 0.5 mm, layer 80 um. Tolerance +/-0.25 mm plus +/-0.002 mm/mm. Suggested max 200 x 200 x 200 mm to limit warping. Lead time 'as fast as 1 day' (no range). The page gives the Telford address as the contact but does not say MJF parts are printed in the UK; may be made at a European plant. Min hole and gap not on the page.

machine.notes: at the European 3D printing centre, which may not be Telford

machines.name: Protolabs, injection moulding
machines.notes: Moulds produced in 1-15 days (stated in days, not weeks); standard part lead time 'as fast as 15 days or less'; moulds from GBP 995; tolerance +/-0.08 mm plus resin tolerance. Max part 480 x 980 mm, depth 101 mm from parting line at 3 deg draft; max volume 966,837 mm3; projected area 112,903 mm2. Prototyping suited to under 2,000 parts, on-demand production with no MOQ. Moulding in Telford per the page. Aluminium tooling, so for 2,000 a year a production steel tool elsewhere may be cheaper per part. No minimum wall or draft number on the page read.

machine.model: Allrounder (Golden Edition and S series), 40 to 500 t

machines.name: Rutland Plastics, injection moulding
machines.notes: Home and tooling pages read: 30 moulding machines including a 2,400-tonne Engel (largest stated), in-house toolroom (40+ machines), low-volume / pre-production and multi-cavity stack tools, partner tools in European steel, 7 million parts a year. Tooling lead time not stated. Materials and design-guideline pages (https://rutlandplastics.co.uk/design-guidelines/, https://www.rutlandplastics.co.uk/services/moulding/plastic-materials/) returned HTTP 429 so materials (PC/ABS), min wall and draft are null. A search snippet (not read as a page) said 50 t to 1,700 t presses and parts up to 1.5 m / 48 kg, which conflicts with the 2,400 t figure on the site. They offer a free downloadable design guide (form required).

machine.model: 2,400 t press (model not named), 30 machines on site

machines.name: Protolabs, CNC machining
machines.notes: Halesfield 8, Telford TF7 4QN. 6061 not mentioned; 6082 and 7075 named. wallMin is nominal 1 mm; regions may go to 0.5 mm if nominal is above 1 mm. holeMin 0.5 mm is for soft metals (1.2 mm hard metals). featureMin 0.5 is minimum recessed-text stroke width. Tolerance typically +/- 0.1 mm. Max size 559 x 356 x 95 mm is labelled 'Max size for Aluminium'; another size 254 x 178 x 95 is also listed. machines.name: Easy Composites, carbon fibre tube

price.source: https://www.easycomposites.co.uk/carbon-fibre-tube (22mm(20mm) Woven Finish Roll Wrapped Carbon Fibre Tube, From £17.95 /M)

machines.notes: Location from https://www.easycomposites.co.uk/contact-us (39 Park Hall Business Village, Stoke on Trent, ST3 5XA). Listing shows OD/ID; wall is derived as (OD-ID)/2, so the 22/20 tube is 1.0 mm wall; the nearest 1.5 mm wall is 25/22. Prices are 'From' per metre; the header says 'excluding VAT' but the VAT toggle default could not be confirmed. Lengths offered are fixed 1000 mm and 2000 mm; no cut-to-length service is mentioned, so maxLength is 2000 from the listing. leadDays 1 is based on 'Order by 1pm (Mon-Fri) for same day dispatch'; that is dispatch, not delivery. Tolerance not published on the listing page. Listing is paginated (32 of 42 shown), so other sizes may exist.
machines.method: sells roll-wrapped prepreg tube (5 to 60 mm OD) and pultruded tube (0.5 to 12 mm OD); does not say whether it makes them

machines.name: Carbon Fibre Tubes Ltd, carbon fibre tube
machines.notes: Company is in Fareham, Hampshire (Unit 31, Fareham Industrial Park, PO16 8XG per https://www.carbonfibretubes.co.uk/contact), not Rotherham as the brief suggested. Standard range is 12 round tubes, all 2500 mm long; 10 mm OD is 1.0 mm wall, all others 1.5 mm. 22/19 (1.5 mm wall) is the direct match for the target. Custom tubing up to 500 mm OD and 5 m long per the homepage. leadDays null: page only says 'the majority of our stock tubing is available to be delivered within days'. Cut-to-length not mentioned. Price and tolerance not published. Clearwater Composites (suggested in the brief) was not used: not confirmed as a UK supplier.
machines.method: roll-wrapped prepreg on platen rolling presses and CNC tape winders, cured out of autoclave

price.basis: per part from (100x100 mm stock, includes toolpath setup, sheet and cutting)

machines.name: Carbon Technology Ltd, carbon fibre plate
machines.notes: Unit 13 Riverside, Bridge Lane, Warrington WA1 4BA. Published sheet sizes are 820 x 625 mm and 3600 x 225 mm (maxLength 3600 is from the second). Carbon Cut UK (Oxfordshire, https://www.carboncutuk.com/) also cuts plate from DXF but publishes no limits. Machines not named on its pages.
